# TruffleHog --exclude-paths rules for .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml.
#
# Full-history scans (schedule, manual runs and new-branch pushes) revisit every
# commit, so a finding stays in history even after the file changes. Each entry
# below was reviewed and contains only public, synthetic test data. Keep every
# rule an anchored, exact path (^...$, dots escaped, no wildcards) so that new
# files are always scanned; scripts/verify-workflows.mjs enforces this.

# SHA-256 digests of bundled brand icons. The icon names (Sentry, Webflow, ...)
# act as detector keywords and the 64-hex digests match their token formats.
^docs/brand-icons-provenance\.json$

# Deliberately public TLS key for the loopback HTTPS server in website-icons.spec.ts.
^tests/e2e/fixtures/website-icons\.test-key\.pem$

# Synthetic credentials embedded in URLs on reserved example domains
# (example.com, *.example, *.example.test, example.invalid). These tests check
# that user info is redacted or rejected before display, storage or requests.
^scripts/interop-316-edge-gpg-fields\.mjs$
^src/core/api-key-fields\.test\.ts$
^src/core/api-token\.test\.ts$
^src/core/website-icon\.test\.ts$
^src/lib/website-icon-cache\.test\.ts$
